content.short: Hexens Cyber Security provides security expertise and smart contract auditing.
content.description: Hexens Cyber Security is dedicated to establishing new security standards for the blockchain ecosystem. The company brings together auditing experts who specialize in diverse information security disciplines, delivering exceptional performance on the most challenging and technically complex tasks. Their work encompasses infrastructure audits, advanced cryptographic methods such as zero-knowledge proofs, and novel cryptography, as well as security assessments for DeFi protocols and NFT projects.
